why: issue 2080 (filed 2026-10-26, the residue of issue 2024, which is resolved): the static helpers read upstream's `rcl_interfaces::msg::ParameterEvent` fields, and the C++ surface cannot name that generated type (no runtime typesupport). A per-parameter callback (`add_parameter_callback`) already receives the decoded `rclcpp::Parameter`; a helper templated over the caller's generated event type is plain work nobody has done.
